view: AP portable (supine/semi-erect), L marker on image right confirming conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate penetration, minimal rotation, apices and both costophrenic regions included; lung volumes modest; left hemithorax partly obscured by overlying tubes, ECG lead and axillary/breast soft-tissue folds; left CP angle partially obscured

devices.type: Chest tube (thoracostomy drain) – enters left lower lateral chest wall, courses medially/superiorly along the left mediastinal border, square tip at the left apex adjacent to the mediastinum; external portion continues down over the left flank
devices.location: left hemithorax, tip at left apex/upper zone

devices.type: Second straight tube running vertically along the left lateral chest wall, square end at about the lateral 3rd rib level – probable second chest tube (lateral/apical) vs external drain tubing
devices.location: left lateral chest wall, upper to lower zone, continuing over the left flank
right anterior chest, mid/lower zone (image left)
left anterior chest, upper zone lateral (image right)

devices.type: Coiled wire/tubing (most likely external ECG cable loops; no NG tube seen in the mediastinum)
devices.location: over the epigastrium / upper abdomen, below the diaphragm

devices.type: L side marker and 'AP PORTABLE' label

abnormalities.finding: No definite visceral pleural line or pleural air space identified on either side; left lung appears essentially re-expanded around the chest tube – any residual pneumothorax would be small and cannot be confirmed
Enlarged cardiomediastinal silhouette / probable cardiomegaly (AP portable magnification limits assessment)
Tortuous / unfolded thoracic aorta with prominent aortic knob
Dense nodular opacities in the right perihilar region, most consistent with calcified hilar lymph nodes
Hazy increased density of the left lower zone with partial obscuration of the left hemidiaphragm – possible small layering effusion / basal atelectasis (overlying breast shadow contributes)
Degenerative changes of the thoracic spine and shoulders

description_zh: AP 攜帶式胸部X光，L 標記位於影像右側，為傳統擺位。左側胸腔可見一條胸管自左下側胸壁進入，沿左縱膈旁向上走行，末端位於左肺尖近縱膈處；另有一條管路沿左側胸壁垂直走行，末端約在第3肋高度，可能為第二條胸管或體外引流管路。雙側肺野未見明確之臟層肋膜線或肋膜腔積氣，左肺大致已擴張，若有殘餘氣胸應屬微量而無法確認。其他所見：雙側心電圖電極與導線、上腹部盤繞之導線（疑體外）、心影擴大（AP 投影限制）、主動脈迂曲、右肺門區鈣化結節狀影（疑鈣化淋巴結），以及左下肺野密度增加、左橫膈輪廓部分模糊。
